model.name: R20.8: Class All-Children = ALL methods + implementations; Traceability Chain = method→impl→test downstream.
model.description: A CLASS scenario unit's detail view: (a) 'All Children' MUST enumerate ALL its methods[] AND all their implementations[] (currently shows only 1 method, missing the rest + impls). The FORWARD_KEYS for Class must resolve both methods AND implementations as children. (b) 'Traceability Chain' from a Class/Method node = the full downstream walk: method → implementation → test. Not just the one chain-relevant method — from the CLASS level, show the chain CONTINUING downward for each method. Screenshot evidence: Class 'Requirement' (14831116) shows only Requirement.classifyType under both sections — missing all other methods + their impls.
model.tronQuote: > TRON: "the class traceability and all children is still wrong. all children should be ALL methods and the implementations. the traceability chain should be method, impl, test… from here."
model.crossRefNote: R20.5 (universal chain-vs-children) defines the general rule. R20.8 is the CLASS-SPECIFIC application: Class.allChildren = methods[]+implementations[]; Class.chain = method→impl→test downstream.

intendedChain.useCase: classDetail.resolveChildren — Class detail enumerates ALL methods + ALL impls; chain walks downstream
intendedChain.class: Server trace-children API (FORWARD_KEYS for Class type)
intendedChain.method: /api/trace/children for type=Class → return methods[] + implementations[]; chain-walk continues method→impl→test
intendedChain.test: RED: (1) open Class 'Requirement' (14831116) detail → All Children shows ALL methods (not just 1) + all impls. Currently FAILS (shows 1). (2) Traceability Chain from Class → shows method→impl→test path for each chain-relevant method.
